title: Manage ads by the numbers not effort
description: Manage ads by the numbers not effort
transcript: So we wanna make sure that after we spend a couple of thousand dollars in spend, as we get to 2, three, 4, 5,000 dollars in spend, that we are looking at this original sheet and making sure the numbers are in KPI. And this is how I really manage my ads. It's not on how hard I work to launch the ads. It's not on how cool the ad was originally. It's quite frankly, do the ads give me the metrics that I need in order to scale? Do they at least have the early indicators that I need in order to scale? And that's really important as you start to get in a couple of thousand dollars a day and spend, because that's quite a bit of money that's leaving your bank account every single day. And especially for running some kind of high ticket business like a lot of our clients are, you wanna make sure that you have full confidence that down the road you're going to get your money back. So you might see that the cost per click is $7. That might make you feel comfortable that I'm gonna get my money back. But if I see the cost per click is $16, even with the absolute best show rate and the best close rate, it's very unlikely that campaign's gonna make me profitable.
